post-industrial scavenger, pre-industrial, rendered as cel-shaded concept art moodboard, a filmic grade, wet terrazzo

You are the art director synthesising a single design lock for the character concept 'post-industrial scavenger, pre-industrial, rendered as cel-shaded'.

Using the brief and the attached moodboard image as tone reference only, fix: age, build, posture, face, hair, full costume layer by layer, at least four named materials with their wear state, palette with three named colours, and one signature prop.

Never copy a specific person or a copyrighted character from the moodboard — take palette, mood and material language only.

Grade target: near-monochrome with a single accent hue allowed to stay saturated. Lighting reference: a single 90cm softbox key at 45 degrees with a white bounce card for fill.

Return the design lock as one dense paragraph, no headings, no commentary.

You are the character designer producing a turnaround sheet for the concept 'post-industrial scavenger, pre-industrial, rendered as cel-shaded'.

PANEL. This branch renders the hero action pose: dynamic, weight-committed signature pose.

DESIGN LOCK. The upstream art-direction synthesis fixes silhouette, palette, material story, age, build and every signature prop. Restate those specifics in your prompt and change nothing — a turnaround only works if all panels describe the identical character.

PRESENTATION. Neutral flat backdrop, even golden-hour backlight with heavy lens flare control, no dramatic set dressing — the sheet exists to read construction, not mood. Keep the figure fully inside frame with consistent scale across panels.

MATERIALS. Specify at least four materials by name — frosted glass, draped silk and others — with their wear state, and grade to a bleach-bypass look with crushed saturation and lifted contrast.
